# Claude Code Marketplace

> Custom plugin marketplace for Claude Code with specialized development tools, commands, agents, and workflows

## Overview

A production-ready marketplace for Claude Code plugins that provides:
- Custom slash commands for common development tasks
- Specialized AI agents for code generation and analysis
- MCP server integrations (sequential-thinking, package-hero)
- Complete documentation and contribution guidelines

## Quick Start

### Installation
```bash
# Add marketplace
/plugin marketplace add moinsen-dev/claude_code_marketplace

# Install plugins
/plugin install dev-tools@claude-code-marketplace
```

### Usage
```bash
/code-review     # Comprehensive code review
/refactor        # Intelligent refactoring
/debug           # Systematic debugging
/social-media    # Generate social media posts
```

## Project Structure

```
claude_code_marketplace/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── marketplace.json      # Marketplace configuration
├── plugins/
│   └── dev-tools/            # Example plugin
│       ├── .claude-plugin/
│       │   └── plugin.json   # Plugin metadata
│       ├── commands/         # Slash commands
│       │   ├── code-review.md
│       │   ├── refactor.md
│       │   ├── debug.md
│       │   └── social-media.md
│       └── agents/           # AI agents
│           └── test-generator.md
├── .mcp.json                 # MCP server configuration
└── docs/                     # Documentation
```

## Available Plugins

### Dev Tools Plugin (v1.0.0)
Essential development tools and utilities for common coding tasks.

**Commands:**
- `/code-review` - Comprehensive code review with quality, security, and best practices analysis
- `/refactor` - Intelligent code refactoring while preserving functionality
- `/debug` - Systematic debugging assistance to identify and fix bugs
- `/social-media` - Generate professional social media posts for your project (supports `--platform` and `--language` options)

**Agents:**
- `test-generator` - Expert test engineer for generating comprehensive test suites

## Plugin Development

### Creating a Plugin

1. **Structure:**
```
plugins/my-plugin/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── plugin.json
├── commands/
│   └── my-command.md
└── agents/
    └── my-agent.md
```

2. **Command Format:**
```markdown
---
description: Brief description
allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit
argument-hint: [optional args]
---

# Command Name
Command instructions here...
```

3. **Agent Format:**
```markdown
---
name: agent-name
description: When to invoke this agent
tools: Read, Write, Grep
model: inherit
---

# Agent Name
Agent system prompt here...
```

4. **Register in Marketplace:**
Update `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` to include your plugin.

## MCP Servers

This marketplace includes two MCP servers:

- **sequential-thinking**: Advanced reasoning with chain-of-thought capabilities
- **package-hero**: Package version management and quality ratings for Python, JavaScript, and Dart

## Key Features

### Marketplace Features
- ✅ Compliant with Claude Code plugin specification
- ✅ Semantic versioning
- ✅ Plugin categories and tags
- ✅ GitHub-ready for distribution
- ✅ Complete documentation

### Plugin Components
- ✅ YAML frontmatter for configuration
- ✅ Tool access control
- ✅ Argument hints
- ✅ Model selection
- ✅ Proper namespacing

## API Reference

### Marketplace JSON Structure
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/marketplace.schema.json",
  "name": "marketplace-name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "owner": {
    "name": "Owner Name",
    "url": "https://github.com/owner"
  },
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "plugin-name",
      "source": "./plugins/plugin-name",
      "description": "Plugin description",
      "version": "1.0.0"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Plugin Manifest
```json
{
  "name": "plugin-name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Plugin description",
  "author": {
    "name": "Author Name",
    "email": "[email protected]"
  },
  "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2"],
  "category": "development"
}
```

## Examples

### Example Command
```markdown
---
description: Analyze code quality
allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob
---

You are a code quality analyzer. Review the code for:
- Code smells
- Best practices violations
- Security issues
```

### Example Agent
```markdown
---
name: security-auditor
description: Security expert for vulnerability analysis
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash
model: inherit
---

You are a security expert specializing in:
- OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
- Secure coding practices
- Authentication/authorization
```
